Id=ansibleforms-rte.service
Description=AnsibleForms RTE (ansibleforms)
User=ansibleforms
WorkingDirectory={{DIR}}/current/server
EnvironmentFiles={{DIR}}/rte.env (ignore_errors=no)
ExecStart={ path={{DIR}}/current/node/bin/node ; argv[]={{DIR}}/current/node/bin/node --preserve-symlinks index.js ; ignore_errors=no ; start_time=[n/a] ; stop_time=[n/a] ; pid=0 ; code=(null) ; status=0/0 }
ActiveState=active
